report_name: MediaLab Ventures Discloses Data Breach Exposing SSNs

identities.name: MediaLab Ventures
identities.description: Technology holding company for brands like Imgur and Kik that reported a data breach exposing first and last names and Social Security numbers of an undisclosed number of individuals. The company filed a notice with the Massachusetts attorney general on November 6, 2026.

identities.name: Imgur
identities.description: An online image sharing and hosting service owned by MediaLab Ventures. Users of the platform were mentioned as being affected by the parent company's data breach.

identities.name: Kik
identities.description: A freeware instant messaging mobile app owned by MediaLab Ventures. Users of the platform were mentioned as being affected by the parent company's data breach.
